commands: npx vitest run --passWithNoTests --reporter=json --reporter=dot --reporter=tools/test-tiers-reporter.mjs --outputFile.json=<dir>/<workspace>.json <the workspace test files>, one workspace at a time
node --test <file>, one file at a time
measured.note: durationS is measured wall time of one file inside its workspace run; vitest files are the tracked time of tools/test-tiers-reporter.mjs (import, collect, setup and test phases), node files are the wall time of node --test on the file
